scope: A deliberately small, high-value crosswalk of standardized DRH questions whose semantics are narrow enough to map into NOEMA first-principles facets. Unmapped DRH questions remain searchable source metadata.
rules: Question text is checked at import so a reused ID with changed meaning cannot silently inherit a mapping.
Yes/No/unknown are taken from DRH answer coding; missing answers are not synthesized.
A mapped DRH answer is still an expert-coded source assertion, not an archaeological observation or metaphysical truth.
Branching population, date range, region, poll and entry identity remain attached.
Fasting is mapped as ritual/ascetic practice unless a source explicitly identifies altered-state induction.
Intoxicant use is not mapped to a specific psychoactive class without substance identification.
Trance-possession communication is mapped to reported/attested phenomenology, not proof of an external agent.
